title: Wire recipes list to present RecipeDetailSheet on tap
description: Modify the recipes list view introduced in spec 0003 to present RecipeDetailSheet(recipe:) as a sheet when a recipe row is tapped. Use .sheet(item:) with the tapped Recipe as the identifiable item. No NavigationStack push — sheet presentation only. A nil selection dismisses the sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping a recipe row opens RecipeDetailSheet as a modal sheet.
Presentation uses .sheet(item:) with the tapped Recipe as the identifiable item.
Swipe-down and X-button dismiss both work.
Presentation is a sheet, not a NavigationStack push.
Tapping a different row after dismissal opens the correct recipe.

handoff_summary.completed: Verified that RecipesListView.swift (lines 25–27, 60–62) already correctly wires .sheet(item: $selectedRecipe) with RecipeDetailSheet(recipe:). RecipeFile.swift confirms Identifiable conformance via id: URL { url }. RecipeDetailSheet has @Environment(\.dismiss) for X-button dismissal. All five acceptance criteria are met.
handoff_summary.next_action: Proceed to tester bead to verify sheet presentation behavior.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Implementation was already present from B-2a638e42 dependency. .sheet(item:) with RecipeFile (Identifiable) is the correct SwiftUI idiom used.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Sheet presentation wiring should be covered by UI tests: tap row → sheet appears, swipe down → dismissed, tap different row → correct recipe shown.
